focuses.title: An Agreed Guarantor Settlement
focuses.requirements: The Cypriot constitutional government is in office. Greece, Turkey, Britain and Cyprus must accept the security settlement.
focuses.description: A negotiated security settlement offers a durable alternative to a short military opening. It preserves Cypriot sovereignty and requires all four governments to accept their obligations.
effect_lines: If they accept: Cypriot Security Settlement

focuses.title: Reinforce the National Guard
focuses.requirements: Cyprus is independent and consents. Greece has the complete personnel and equipment reserve. Cyprus owns and controls a valid deployment location. Greece and Cyprus are at peace and impose no embargo or sanctions on each other.
focuses.description: Greek personnel and arms can reinforce the Cypriot National Guard before a landing decides the crisis. Two formed light infantry divisions pass into Cypriot command as soon as the Republic accepts. Greece gives up the men and weapons from its own reserves. The contribution supports the island while leaving Athens free to choose limited aid or full military intervention later.
effect_lines: If they accept: Greek Reinforcements for Cyprus

focuses.title: Proclaim Full Enosis
focuses.requirements: The independent Cypriot coup government remains in office and holds both island states. Cyprus receives the union demand. Peaceful annexation requires Cypriot acceptance and resolution of the Turkish reaction.
focuses.description: The coup can become the opening for Enosis itself. A union ratified in Athens and Nicosia brings Cypriot territory, ports, airfields and armed forces into Greece. The Turkish Cypriot question and opposition from Ankara make this the most ambitious and exposed course. An explicit Cypriot rejection instead gives Athens an annexation war goal. Until a civil settlement takes root, Greece must carry the cost of governing a divided society.

focuses.title: Negotiate Southern Enosis
focuses.requirements: A real territorial partition has already been settled. The independent Cypriot coup government holds only the south, while Turkey or Northern Cyprus holds the north.
focuses.description: A government unable to unite the island may instead negotiate union of the south with Greece. Recognizing the northern settlement gives Ankara a concrete concession and reduces the burden on Athens. Greece obtains Nicosia and the remaining Cypriot institutions while surrendering the full-island objective. An explicit refusal by Nicosia allows Athens to pursue the southern claim by force. The British sovereign bases lie outside the bargain.
effect_lines: If they accept: A Negotiated Southern Union

starting_spirits.name: Maritime and Tourism Expansion
starting_spirits.description: Shipping, tourism and external earnings are real strengths of the economy. Their international exposure also limits economic autonomy.
starting_spirits.remedy: A continuing structural strength with a continuing external dependence.

starting_spirits.name: 1960 Treaty of Guarantee

starting_spirits.remedy: Retained as the treaty basis of the guarantor paths. No automatic annexation, partition or sovereign control.

crisis_intervention.intervention_commitment: Military bonuses start only with an actual declared Turkish intervention. They end at180days or related peace, whichever occurs first. A reversal from restraint reuses the original crisis receipt and never refreshes a used bonus or setup grant.
crisis_intervention.crisis_cancellation: All deadlines are relative to army-crisis activation, not the original consultation date. Explicit refusal activates immediately; no-action or failed diplomacy activates after the30-day intervention window. Any successful intervention, accepted security resolution or completed civilian-control settlement marks the army-crisis instance closed before removing the spirit. All pending30/60/180-day outcomes require the same still-active instance and therefore become no-ops. The original180-day intervention expiry receipt is separate and cannot be restarted.
crisis_intervention.coup_outcome: At day60: pressure>=60 installs the dated native military-junta government; pressure36..59 produces a defeated plot and stability-5%; pressure<=35 with the two control measures defeats the plot. A takeover does not automatically declare another war.
crisis_intervention.scheduler: One-shot crisis events at30,60and180days. Flags/instance receipts discard stale events. Existing monthly fallback only; no new daily or weekly relationship observer.
crisis_intervention.historical_status: The Angry General Staff refusal response and simultaneous full NATO exits/automatic returns are requested RP alternate history. Historical Greece left integrated military command in1974, remained an Alliance member, and returned to the integrated structure in1980.

historical_start.government: Prime Minister Georgios Papadopoulos; Regent Georgios Zoitakis; King Constantine II in exile.
historical_start.parties: Domestic parties are banned. ERE, Centre Union, EDA and KKE represent historical constituencies. PAK is an exile resistance movement. ND and PASOK are founded in 1974, not lawful parties in January 1970. KKE Interior constituencies appear inside the broad-left alternative, not an invented MD party slot.
historical_start.institutions: Greece remains a NATO member and a kingdom. EEC association is restricted, not membership. Withdrawal from the Council of Europe was notified in December 1969; legal membership ends in December 1970.
historical_start.economy: Strong shipping, tourism and growth coexist with regional inequality, emigration and shortages of technical expertise. No custom workforce-size penalties.
historical_start.later: The Ioannidis takeover, the July 1974 Cyprus coup, democratization, European accession and the 1983 health-system precedent inform reachable alternatives rather than scripted inevitabilities.

implementation_contract.party_programmes: Keep all branches visible. Exact existing native party-in-power triggers gate availability and execution. Rebuild each party-owned dynamic modifier from earned receipts only while that party governs; named leader subprogrammes require that leader as well. Disable their weekly streams on departure; restore on return. Never replay buildings, slots, research, XP, setup fees or one-time starting-spirit remedies. State constitutional settlements and signed bilateral agreements retain their separate state conditions.
implementation_contract.refresh: Existing party/leader change callbacks plus one GRE monthly reconciliation. Fixed CYP/GRE crisis participants and explicit offer partners only. No new daily or weekly script observer, no every_country loops or global monthly offer searches. Budget streams use existing MD weekly accounting, with literals of at most five decimal places.
implementation_contract.party_identity: Use actual native party-name localisation keys. Slot 1 uses the dated ERE/ND identity; slot 3 the dated PAK/PASOK identity. Correct the native 1970 slot23 display to Royalists because the kingdom still exists; reserve restoration language for an actual subsequent abolition. Preserve existing slot alignment, including slot7 State Emergency Hardliners. Do not activate banned parties automatically.
implementation_contract.civilian_transfer: Negotiate a Civilian Handover proposes a one-time domestic event with actual Kanellopoulos conservative or Mavros Centre Union caretaker cabinets, preserving the existing native party/leader dispatcher. A cabinet already under civilian rule is not overwritten. This is a hypothetical negotiated alternative, not a claim of a real January 1970 deal. Actual civilian authority ends Emergency Rule. The following amnesty and election focuses restore competition; PAK/PASOK and KKE may later govern through the native party system. The Crown remains constitutionally unsettled until the explicit settlement fork. Papadopoulos and Ioannidis internal choices also route to real government/leader snapshots rather than cosmetic names.
implementation_contract.offer_lifecycle: A Greek national focus proposes each unique contract. Named RP recipients receive accept/refuse decisions with full prospective numeric effects for all participants. The pending offer expires after 90 days, cleaned by monthly/event callbacks. An unpaid declined or expired offer may be resent once by a single Greek event option with no home-country decision menu; one active offer per contract. Every required recipient must agree to identical terms. Payment, ownership, capacity, existence, independence where required, party proposer and relation guards recheck at acceptance. No unilateral rewards. Setup and one-time assets commit atomically only once all approvals and all guards succeed. Permanent standing spirits suspend and restore together without repeating charges or assets.
implementation_contract.community: Snapshot only the current native global.EU_member, excluding GRE, for one proposal round. Use exact count N for Greek expense N x 0.004% Greek GDP per week and each member income 0.004%. Six is only the January 1970 preview. Membership or passed-law changes invalidate pending terms. Accession replaces association spirits and charges. Before consent, a native preview helper enumerates every applicable effect of current EU_passed_votes as well as all seven base EU_member modifiers, research and money. At concept snapshot no specific passed laws are assumed. Add EU_member through its native on_add only after admission. No EU_join helper or custom membership roster.
implementation_contract.community_setup_correction: After the erroneous inherited Greek EU_member is removed through its native on_remove, synchronize native member/law/tech-sharing cleanup and explicitly clear the artificial EU_former_member and EU_rejoin_cooldown flags. Greece was never a former member. Prevent the history/generator from restoring the error. Begin with Restricted European Association. Do not touch other actual members.
implementation_contract.buildings: Every building level first adds one shared slot in the same state inside the same asset receipt. Actual target ownership, control, native building cap and available state capacity are separate guards. Failure never charges setup money or creates orphan slots. A recipient asset uses that recipient ownership, not Greek ownership.
implementation_contract.cyprus_preparation: The extra +10 staff penetration uses a unique timed receipt and clamp 0..100. It expires after 180 days or on network withdrawal/crisis cancellation; remove the contribution once and clear the receipt. Existing withdrawal remains -20, plus -10 when preparation is active. A resolved coup consumes the contribution receipt. No double subtraction after resolution. Remove Forward Operational Planning when cancelled.
implementation_contract.cyprus_resolution: Reuse the existing deterministic 14-day warning: captured defence is 40 plus Cypriot preparedness, and Greek penetration must strictly exceed it. A tie defends. No random roll or periodic roll. Operational Initiative is once only after real coup success with the coup government still in power, peaceful GRE-CYP relations and no sanctions/embargo. Completion rechecks these guards. Its weekly charge stops on loss of eligibility or the 180-day expiry.
implementation_contract.settlement: The four governments are Cyprus plus the three guarantors, not four guarantors. Require separate Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot assent receipts from the Cypriot communal programme. All six state pairs are checked in both sanction directions. Suspend and restore all four settlement spirits collectively. Close the existing security-crisis receipt on successful settlement.
implementation_contract.nato: Retain installed CYP_R2 war and NATO APIs and all nine existing Greek shared-focus IDs, relocating their anchors after approval. Direct Greek entry removes prior GRE/TUR NATO memberships before joining the actual CYP-TUR war. Return each prior member only after both GRE-TUR and CYP-TUR peace. This is the requested alternative-history full Alliance exit; historical Greece withdrew only from integrated military command in 1974. New Aegean Expeditionary Command is a once-only 180-day direct-entry reward: +10% army and navy organization, +25% planning, +15% maximum planning, +20% amphibious attack, +30% invasion preparation, -10% office income and +0.05% Greek GDP weekly expense. Require actual successful entry on Cyprus side. End that package on related Greek-Turkish peace or 180 days; never end NATO separation merely because the reward expires. No automatic divisions, aircraft or ships are created. Real volunteer formations still require the actual native deployment action and Cypriot approval. Same-faction deployment compatibility remains a live-engine check.
implementation_contract.new_helpers: COLDWAR_GRE_R2_politics events, programme refresh, recipient offers, dynamic law preview, staff receipt cleanup and post-coup reward helpers are proposed new work. Their names in this concept do not imply installed definitions.
implementation_contract.entry_transaction: Wrap the existing escalation helper in a single guarded completion transaction. Verify independence, war sides, funds and native entry eligibility before snapshots and debit. After add_to_war, require actual GRE-TUR war, CYP-TUR war, no GRE-CYP war and the entry receipt before issuing the separate expeditionary package receipt and weekly active receipt. The previous helper entry flag alone does not prove success. If native entry fails, grant no package or stream, refund exactly the captured 100 PP and 1.5% Greek-GDP debit and undo only this attempt NATO changes through native helpers with the saved prior memberships. Clear the failed attempt separation receipts before rollback, not an unrelated active crisis. No permanent faction loss after a failed war join. Do not replay a completed successful entry.
implementation_contract.reinforcements: New independent 7-day Reinforce the National Guard focus offers two CYP-owned 18-width light infantry divisions. Six L_Inf_Bat each, exactly1200 manpower and1200 infantry weapons,120 light anti-tank,120 anti-air and120 CNC equipment per division. Greece loses the complete two-division reserve, Cyprus receives fully formed units immediately on consent. Available before Turkish intervention; no dependency or exclusion with Volunteers or Fight Beside Cyprus. This is a one-time paid unit transfer, not a starting OOB, free reserve, standing spirit or change of belligerent status. Use explicit Greek stockpile debit plus unit generation; do not also transfer a second equipment package. The new transaction data and REINFORCEMENT_REFERENCE.md define the native engine conservation fixture. No extra monthly observer. Independent Cypriot consent and controlled landing area are required. Historical precedent is the exceptional1964-67 deployment, not an automatic Treaty of Guarantee entitlement.
implementation_contract.replacement: After approval: archive old Greek content outside the mod on E:, update its original generator and emitted tree, remove stale custom focus/idea/event references, integrate the approved data and preserve the existing Cyprus shared-focus identities. No deletion or installation performed by this concept build.
